name: Graphify
description: Maps a codebase, docs, PDFs, and media into a queryable knowledge graph so AI coding assistants trace and cite paths instead of grepping through files.

skills.name: Build Knowledge Graph
skills.description: Parses roughly 40 languages locally with tree-sitter AST to build a graph of calls, imports, and inheritance edges, with no LLM.

skills.name: Query Graph Naturally
skills.description: Answers plain-language questions by returning a scoped subgraph from the built graph.json without re-reading any source files.

skills.name: Trace Node Paths
skills.description: Traces the shortest path between two concepts and explains one node connections, tagging each edge EXTRACTED or INFERRED.

skills.name: Detect Graph Communities
skills.description: Splits the graph into subsystems with Leiden community detection and surfaces god nodes, the most-connected concepts in a project.

skills.name: Serve Graph Over MCP
skills.description: Exposes query_graph, get_node, get_neighbors, and shortest_path to assistants over MCP stdio or Streamable HTTP transport.
